LESSON: SMELL ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.7: Smell ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Smell ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What part of the body ENVIRONMENT strand, the learner environment and identify different is used in smelling?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Smell ENVIRONMENT
2. Give Kenyan examples for Smell ENVIRONMENT
3. Practise Smell ENVIRONMENT at school and at home
